description: List upcoming family events in a city Kyds Activities serves (pass `city`; defaults to Lodi, CA) — open houses, workshops, community days, storytimes, sports clinics. Different from `search_programs` (ongoing classes) — these are single-day or short-window events.

category.description: Filter by event category: workshop, open_house, community, showcase, fundraiser, camp_session, storytime, sports_clinic.

city.description: City slug to search in (e.g. 'lodi', 'galt'). Defaults to Lodi. Call list_cities for the current list.

name: list_upcoming_events
